reason: Rockstar Games is a ~3,400-3,900-person subsidiary of publicly traded Take-Two Interactive ($1.4B annual revenue, HQ New York, 10+ studios across 51 countries) - roughly 25x the top of Ben Cole's stated 20-150-employee range for US-based funded independent studios, and far too large for a fractional technical-operations engagement. No senior-engineers-pulled-into-ops gap to redescribe.
